applicableAreas: all buildings
findings.comment: Site plan shows buildings and overhead distribution lines but does not include building elevation sheets with surveyed conductor elevations or horizontal clearance dimensions from the outside conductor to building faces, overhangs, or roof edges. Compliance with the 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance requirement cannot be verified without these documented clearances.

applicableAreas: all buildings
findings.comment: Site plan shows buildings and distribution lines but does not document radial clearance dimensions from the outside conductor of distribution primary and neutral conductors to building faces or structures. The required 15-foot radial clearance cannot be verified from available plan documentation.

applicableAreas: all buildings
findings.comment: No building elevation sheets provided showing building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, decks, patios) with clearance dimensions from the outside conductor. Both 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances for building projections cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: buildings adjacent to western and southern property boundaries
findings.comment: Overhead distribution lines shown on site plan along western and southern property boundaries. Building setback distances from property lines and surveyed conductor elevations/locations are not documented. Compliance with 7.5-foot horizontal and 15-foot radial clearances from overhead facilities adjacent to site cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: all buildings
findings.comment: Site plan does not include building elevation sheets with surveyed conductor elevation data and clearance dimension annotations from registered surveyor. Registered surveyor data required to verify clearances from overhead electric facilities is not provided.

applicableAreas: all buildings
findings.comment: Site plan and grading plan do not include section or profile view exhibits showing dimension lines from outer electric conductor to outermost edges of buildings and building projections. Clearance verification cannot be completed without these cross-sectional exhibits.

applicableAreas: pond perimeter fence and property perimeter fences
findings.comment: Site plan shows fences (pond perimeter fence and landscape privacy fences) but does not document clearance dimensions from the outside conductor of overhead electric lines to fence faces. The required 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: property perimeter and pond perimeter fences
findings.comment: Site plan shows a power pole near the northwest corner and fence locations but does not include dimension annotations verifying fence post locations maintain minimum 10-foot horizontal clearance from the electric pole.

applicableAreas: pond perimeter fence
findings.comment: Site plan shows a transmission easement on Sheet 3 with transmission line requirements stating fencing within the easement must be non-conductive and properly grounded. The transmission easement boundary is not shown on the site plan, and specifications for fence material, construction, and grounding details are not provided. Fencing materials and grounding compliance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: retaining walls on site perimeter and around detention pond
findings.comment: Site plan and grading plan show retaining walls around detention pond and site perimeter but do not document clearance dimensions from the outside conductor of overhead electric lines to wall surfaces. The required 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: retaining walls on site perimeter and around detention pond
findings.comment: Grading plan shows retaining wall locations but does not include cross-section exhibits with dimension lines showing clearances from the outer electric conductor to retaining wall faces. Clearance verification requires section views with documented dimensions.

applicableAreas: internal driveways
findings.comment: Site plan and grading plan show driveways but do not document vertical clearance dimensions from the lowest point of overhead electric facilities (including telecommunications attachments) to finished driveway grades. No registered surveyor mid-span clearance data provided to verify the minimum 16-foot vertical clearance requirement is maintained.

applicableAreas: surface parking areas and garage areas
findings.comment: Site plan shows 10 surface parking spaces and 78 garage parking spaces beneath buildings but does not document minimum vertical clearance dimensions from overhead electric lines to finished grades. Vertical clearance requirements (16 feet for parking areas without truck traffic) cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: internal driveways, site grading areas adjacent to transmission easement
findings.comment: Sheet 3 specifies requirements for roads and driveways within transmission easements, including 30-foot vertical clearance from transmission lines to ground surface and 46,000 lb. tandem axle structural requirements. The transmission easement boundary is not depicted on the grading plan, and no vertical clearance dimensions or structural capacity specifications are documented. Transmission structure locations are not shown, preventing verification of compliance.

applicableAreas: all plan sheets with potential clearance dimensions
findings.comment: Site plan documentation provides no clearance dimensions annotated on any plans. Where clearances are depicted, dimension lines must originate from the outside conductor (not pole centerline or pole structure). Since no dimensions are shown, the requirement to measure from the outside conductor cannot be verified. All dimensions must be revised to originate from the actual conductor location.

applicableAreas: trash enclosure/receptacle locations
findings.comment: Site plan does not clearly identify trash enclosure locations relative to overhead electric facilities. Clearance verification for trash bin receptacles beneath overhead lines cannot be completed without documented clearance dimensions accounting for trash bin raised height during service collection.

applicableAreas: all buildings, detention pond, driveways, parking, fences, structures within transmission easement
findings.comment: Sheet 3 references a transmission easement with specific prohibitions on permanent structures, detention ponds, and facilities that would impair Austin Energy access. The transmission easement boundary is not depicted on the site plan or grading plan. Compliance with the prohibition against customer facilities under/over distribution lines and the 7.5-foot clearance requirement for items within electric easements cannot be verified without the easement boundary clearly shown.

applicableAreas: driveways, parking areas
findings.comment: Driveways and parking areas appear to be located beneath or adjacent to overhead electric facilities with potentially marginal vertical clearances. No registered surveyor data showing pole locations and mid-span clearance measurements are provided. When overhead facilities may not meet minimum vertical clearance requirements, a registered surveyor survey is required to document clearances at midspan.

applicableAreas: exterior lighting fixtures
findings.comment: Landscape and site plans show exterior lighting is required (Site Plan notes require full cut-off, fully shielded fixtures per Subchapter E 2.5) but do not document clearance verification dimensions showing the 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances from overhead electric lines to decorative lighting fixtures.

applicableAreas: landscape planting areas within transmission easement and adjacent to overhead conductors
findings.comment: Sheet 3 transmission requirements specify no trees planted within 25 feet of transmission structures and within the transmission easement. The transmission easement boundary is not shown on the landscape plan, and tree locations are not dimensioned with lateral clearances from transmission structure bases or conductors. Landscape plan does not verify that proposed tree species are utility-compatible per ECM Appendix F, nor document distances from transmission and distribution conductors.

applicableAreas: site perimeter where down guy wires from distribution poles may exist
findings.comment: Sheet 3 transmission notes explicitly reference down guy anchors from transmission and distribution poles, specifying 25-foot no-dig buffer and restrictions on structures/paths conflicting with down guys. Site plan does not show down guy wire locations, anchor points, or related easements despite the power pole visible at northwest corner. Down guy wire conflicts with proposed accessible paths and driveways cannot be resolved without these features depicted.

applicableAreas: transmission structure guy anchorages
findings.comment: Site plan references a transmission easement on Sheet 3, but the easement exhibit (Plat Sheet 2) does not show or describe guy easements for transmission down guys, which require 10-foot width either side of guy wire plus 50-foot extension beyond anchor point.

applicableAreas: distribution pole down guy anchor on site
findings.comment: Site plan shows power pole near northwest corner but does not depict down guy anchor locations or dedicated easements. Easement exhibit does not show down guy anchor easement boundaries (10-foot width extending 5 feet past anchor ground entry point) required for distribution poles.

applicableAreas: pole-mounted and pad-mounted transformers shown on electrical plan
findings.comment: Electrical design plan shows transformer locations but does not provide cross-section or elevation views with vertical clearance dimensions from overhead electric line conductors to the top of transformer equipment. The minimum 7.5-foot vertical sky-to-ground clearance cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: cover sheet and general notes
findings.comment: Site plan set contains overhead electric lines on property and will involve construction activities. Plans do not include the required note that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003. This notification requirement must be added to the cover sheet or general notes.
